Titles.eng: Dragon Ball Z: The World's Strongest
Titles.jpn: ドラゴンボールZ この世で一番強いヤツ

Summaries.eng: While looking at the Dragon Radar, Oolong notices that all of the Dragon Balls are starting to be gathered together. He and Gohan, who were also searching for the Dragon Balls, head out to investigate and end up at the Tsurumai-Tsuburi Mountains’ eternal wall of ice, where coincidentally, Piccolo is also training. Dr. Kochin summons Shenron and wishes for Dr.  Wheelo’s lab to be released from the ice. The ice begins to break away and a building emerges. Gohan and Oolong look on in disbelief, when they are suddenly attacked by Dr. Kochin’s Biomen. Piccolo shows up to save Gohan, but is overcome by three mysterious fighters, while Gohan and Oolong escape.
Summaries.jpn: 五十年の時を経て、神龍の力で蘇った悪の天才科学者Ｄｒ.ウィロー。狙いは世界最強の肉体だ。Dr．ウィローに攫われた亀仙人とブルマを追って、かけつけた悟空たちの前に立ちふさがったのは、なんとDr.ウィローに洗脳されたピッコロだった！

Aliases: Dragon Ball Z Movie 02 - The World's Strongest
